text: Gemiverse. Every student gets a Gemi: an AI you, living on campus.
It lives on a small daily budget of real tokens that it plans itself.
Ask in any language. It brings back three things, every field checked against its source, or not shown.
It sealed a guess before you chose, then shows if it was right.
On 122 unseen pages from six universities: 3.2 percent wrong, against 8.4 for one model call. Our first run lost. We show that too.
Fifteen corrections logged. Gemini Carbon designed the base and reviewed us.
Go to a real event, a keepsake arrives. It saves stars to open new rooms and meet other Gemis.
It would rather miss than be wrong.
